Elevate your lifestyle with this exceptional townhome situated in an exclusive, upscale neighbourhood. Immerse yourself in the serene beauty of an expansive rooftop deck, perfect for entertaining or simply savouring the picturesque vistas where breathtaking water, city, and mountain views await. Step into the private master suite offers a retreat-like ambiance with its spacious layout, walk-in closet, and lavish bathroom featuring a soaker tub and separate shower. Maple hardwood floors and stylish glass railings enhance the home's elegance, while the gourmet kitchen, equipped with high-end appliances, ensures a seamless culinary experience.

Description
Make yourself at home in Vancouver's West End. This two-level townhouse pairs a garden patio and private rooftop terrace with a living room, gas fireplace and hardwood floors. Enjoy Robson Street shops and restaurants, Davie Village, and weekend plans at English Bay or Stanley Park. Approx. 1,192 sq. ft., 2 bedrooms, 2 full bathrooms plus a powder room, quartz kitchen counters, maple cabinetry, stainless steel appliances, gas range, dishwasher and in-suite laundry. $5,500/month; available December 1, 2026. Unfurnished; minimum one-year lease; utilities extra. One off-street parking space included; no storage. Pets considered case-by-case. Some photos digitally decluttered. Contact David Siccia, Licensed Property Manager, Heller Murch Realty, 236-998-5841. https://davidsicciaproperties.ca

Primary and secondary bedrooms are located on the main level with one bathroom and a ensuite to the primary. Downstairs holds the third bedroom, full bathroom, private laundry, and a large 4th bedroom (no closet) /could also be used as a rec room/office/ kids play area- the options are endless!
